title: Change Australian residency status on a NSW driver licence
summary: Visit a Service NSW Centre to update your driver licence details if your Australian residency status changes.
intro: If your Australian residency status changes, you'll need to visit a Service NSW Centre to update your driver licence details.
who_can_apply: Your Australian residency status has changed.
what_you_need: Evidence of Australian citizenship or permanent residency (e.g., citizenship certificate, naturalisation document, passport, or overseas passport)
The appropriate PDF form (Replacement Application or Change of Records)

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and submit your application.

faqs.q: What do I need to update my driver licence?
faqs.a: You need your proof of identity, evidence of Australian citizenship or permanent residency (such as your citizenship certificate, naturalisation document, passport, or overseas passport), the appropriate PDF form, and payment.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my application?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to submit your application.

faqs.q: What forms do I need to complete?
faqs.a: You must download, print, and complete either the Replacement Application (if a replacement licence is needed) or the Change of Records form (if a replacement licence is not required).
